contextLines.description: Number of source lines to include around the definition (default 50).

maxCallees.description: Maximum number of callees to extract from the definition (default 20).

maxCallers.description: Maximum number of callers (references) to return (default 15).

scopePath.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session's working directory.

symbol.description:
Symbol name to analyze (plain or qualified, e.g. `my_func` or 
                 `MyStruct::my_method`).
